name: Valid signature acceptance
description: Sign 5 fixed messages with 5 synthetic P-256 keys and verify each signature with the matching public key. Every verification must return true.

inputs.name: key_count
inputs.description: Synthetic keys generated from the run seed

name: Modified message rejection
description: For each valid (message, signature) pair, flip one bit of the message and verify. Every verification must return false.

inputs.name: pairs
inputs.description: Valid pairs taken from the valid-acceptance test

name: Malformed and out-of-range signature rejection
description: Present 8 malformed signatures (wrong length, r = 0, s = 0, r = n, s = n, r = n-1 with random s, all-ones, truncated) for a valid message. Every verification must return false or raise a documented error.

inputs.name: cases
inputs.description: Fixed malformed cases M-01 to M-08

name: Wycheproof ECDSA P-256 vectors (sample subset)
description: Run the imported 198-vector subset and compare each verification result with the expected result recorded in the vector file.

acceptanceRule.description: 100% of vectors produce the expected result

vectorSource: Project Wycheproof, ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 (subset, re-encoded; sample numbering)

name: Signing and verification latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
description: After a 200-iteration warm-up, time 1000 signatures and 1000 verifications of a fixed message on the reference sandbox profile and report p50, p95 and p99 wall-clock latency for each.

name: Verification throughput
description: Verify as many fixed valid signatures as possible in 10 s on one core and report verifications per second. Informational: no acceptance criterion references it.

name: Key and signature sizes
description: Generate a synthetic key pair and one signature; record public key, private key and signature sizes in bytes.

name: r/s range fuzz (proposed experiment, protocol v1)
description: Sample 2000 out-of-range (r, s) pairs from a seeded generator (r or s in {0, n, n+1, 2n, 2^256-1} combined with random in-range partners) and verify each against a valid message. Records accept/reject per case. Runs only under an approved protocol.

name: Acme CI signing test suite (imported results)
description: Acme's own 412-test suite, run in Acme's CI. Results arrive as a JUnit export and are recorded as an imported run.

acceptanceRule.description: Informational; the suite's own pass/fail is reported as imported

unsupportedReason: This suite runs in Acme's pipeline. No runner here executes customer CI; results are imported through the test_results artifact.

name: Timing side-channel analysis
description: Statistical timing-leak detection on the signing path (fixed-vs-random input classes).

acceptanceRule.description: No statistically significant timing difference between input classes at the stated confidence

unsupportedReason: No constant-time analysis runner is validated in the sandbox. Path: import results from a customer-side measurement, or request an adapter.
